cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Say You Missed Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit longing, jealousy, hurt, or attachment before you reveal your own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Now I'm back, I'm giving you the first word: admit the flat was too quiet without me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you tell me whether you missed me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Reciprocity is approved, in that order. Did you ever hear a key and hope it was mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your request is granted. I rang our landline just to hear you. Now you may say hello again, and I'll try not to pretend I called about a bill.
